heroBanner.subtitle: After several years of art studies and co-founding an artists' collective in Toulouse, I gave my career a new direction by transitioning into front-end development, specializing in React. For more than two years at Kotzilla, a startup based in Toulouse, I combined front-end development and product design to design and develop elegant, functional user experiences.
